Selling brushes and other digital assets sounds simple… until you realize that making the asset is only half the job! After 1,000+ sales, I’ve learned a LOT about what actually makes people click “buy,” what makes them come back, and what turns a good digital product into a great one! Here are the biggest lessons I wish I knew when I started: ★ Make something you’d actually use yourself! Never sell any product you wouldn’t personally endorse, all the brushes I sell are brushes I actively use in my own art. If you want people to trust your product, set a good example! My artwork actively advertises all of my brushes because when people like my art and want to recreate it themselves, I can point them to my shop!  ★ Presentation matters almost as much as the product. Your previews need to sell the result, not just show the files! A good listing that not only catches the eye, but actively shows people what they’ll be buying increasing your chances of someone purchasing your product! My listings show off the brush, the title of the brush, what it can be used for, and some of my artwork using that brush! People don’t read descriptions, put valuable information in your product listings.   ★ Making a product is only half the battle. Advertising is more important because the best product will fail if no one knows it exists or understands why they need to buy it! Find your niche and learn how to reach your audience, a lot of artists would really benefit from learning a thing or two about marketing & branding especially if they want to make a career out of selling.  ★ A great customer experience is part of the product. Anybody can make a brush, but people are choosing to buy from YOU, make it an experience worth while! People who have a good experience purchasing from you are more likely to come back and customer retention/loyalty is so important! Also, your customers are the BEST use of free advertising! If they like the product, they might recommend it to their friends, driving more sales to your shop without any extra hassle :)  ★ You don’t need thousands of followers to make digital assets worth selling.
